summary.text:
I need historical data as of August 2025. The current dataset reflects Nov 2026 and has 9M rows. The task says "according to the Scandinavian MTEB leaderboard (i.e. highest Mean (Task)) as of August 2025." This likely refers to a snapshot knowledge: as of August 2025, which model topped the leaderboard with all tasks. We must find it.

Approach: download current results dataset (114 MB parquet), filter to Scandinavian tasks. Then compute per-model per-task mean, require all 27 tasks, mean of task averages. But results might have changed/models added since Aug 2025. Need data as of Aug 2025 only. We can perhaps use model metadata/creation dates? Or dataset historical commits unavailable via HF API? Maybe GitHub results repo has history? The results are in https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/results possibly, with git history. Let's check.

Also possibly leaderboard has a static cache accessible via HF? The MTEB leaderboard new frontend possibly has data endpoints. We could query the app with gradio API? It's docker likely serving pre-calculated data from dataset. Maybe endpoint.

Also need understand "Mean (Task)" vs "Mean (TaskType)" displayed. In new leaderboard UI, there is overall "Mean (Task)" and "Mean (TaskType)". Highest Mean (Task) with all tasks.

Let's download dataset and inspect. 114 MB fine. Also query git history.

content.text: The current results dataset reflects a later date (Nov 2026), so I must reconstruct the August 2025 state. Let me download the results and also check whether the results repo retains git history from mid-2025.

output.name: bash
output.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/results.git mteb-results-git 2>&1 | tail -5; ls -la /tmp/mteb-results-git 2>/dev/null | head"}

output.name: bash
output.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && for i in 0 1 2 3; do curl -L --fail -sS \"https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/mteb/results/parquet/default/train/$i.parquet\" -o \"results-$i.parquet\" & done; wait; ls -lh /tmp/results-*.parquet"}
